# SpikingNeuralTopology

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The connectivity and event-routing structure of spiking neural circuits, including neuron placement and synaptic pathways. Topology-centric mapping is central to TCC and iNEST for efficient physical realization of spiking networks.
